source_build: Authored. The ids, words, routes and binds of the offered entries are the ones the page's action registry holds (web/packages/app/src/ui/actions/registry.ts) and the plan word of each is the one the planner drafts for it; a test holds this file to both. Family, subjects, cost and loss are stated here for the first time. An id is never renamed or reused: a later version holds every id of this one, retired where it is no longer offered.
fallback: An id this catalog does not hold is no action: it is neither served nor planned.

words.label: Take back
words.hint: Take back the last change to this world

entries.reason: Takes back the last change to a world's placed objects; what it takes back is gone from the world as it stands.

words.label: Place an object
words.hint: Place a reviewed object where you are pointing

entries.reason: Places one reviewed object in a world, the first thing a person builds with.

words.label: Move an object
words.hint: Move an object to where you are pointing

entries.reason: Moves one placed object, so a world can be arranged after it is made.

words.label: Remove an object
words.hint: Take an object out of this world

entries.reason: Takes one placed object out of a world; the object as placed is what is lost.

words.label: Place an arrangement
words.hint: Place a published group of objects in one change

entries.reason: Places a published group of objects in one change of a world.

words.label: Make new pieces for how things look here
words.hint: Ask the piece maker for new pieces of this world's look, after seeing the time and the cost

entries.reason: Asks the piece maker for new pieces of a world's look, which costs generation and is shown with its time and cost first.

words.label: Add a thing
words.hint: Add a thing by its kind, beside something or where you are pointing

entries.reason: Adds a thing or a being to a world by its kind.

words.label: Move a thing
words.hint: Move a placed thing to where you are pointing

entries.reason: Moves one placed thing to another place in its world.

words.label: Remove a thing
words.hint: Take a placed thing out of this world

entries.reason: Takes one placed thing out of a world; the thing as placed is what is lost.

words.label: Ask someone
words.hint: Ask one of the beings here to go to a place or use it

entries.reason: Asks one being of a world to go to a place or use it, which the being's own decision then takes up.

words.label: Choose who decides
words.hint: Give a being, a kind, a role or everyone an AI model, or their own routine back, after seeing what it comes to

entries.reason: Chooses who decides for a being or a group of them; a model chosen is asked at the world's cost, shown before the yes.

words.label: Play this being
words.hint: You choose what one being does, in the world, until you give it back; its mind rests meanwhile

entries.reason: A person starts deciding for one being themselves, which asks no model.

words.label: Give it back
words.hint: Give back the being you play; its own mind decides again

entries.reason: A person gives back the being they play, which is then decided for as it was before.

words.label: Send everyone away
words.hint: Send the people who live here away for now; the world and its history stay

entries.reason: Sends everyone of a world's society away, which bringing them back reverses.

words.label: Bring them back
words.hint: Bring back the people who were sent away

entries.reason: Brings back the people of a world's society who were sent away.

words.label: Bring people in
words.hint: Bring simulated people into this world

entries.reason: Brings simulated people into a world that holds none.

words.label: Play
words.hint: Let the world run on its own

entries.reason: Lets a world's society run on its own, at a speed.

words.label: Pause
words.hint: Stop the world where it is

entries.reason: Stops a world's society where it is.

words.label: Change speed
words.hint: Change how fast the world plays

entries.reason: Changes how fast a world's society runs, and leaves it running or stopped as it was.

words.label: Next minute
words.hint: Advance the world by one minute

entries.reason: Advances a stopped world's society by one minute.

words.label: Create a world
words.hint: Start a new town from a recipe

entries.reason: Makes a new generated world in the caller's workspace.

words.label: Make a creature
words.hint: Describe a creature and add it to this world

entries.reason: The page names this id today for describing a creature; reserved until one route and one plan word carry it.

words.label: Make a world from a sentence
words.hint: Describe a world and have it drafted, after seeing what a draft may spend

entries.reason: Drafting a world from a person's sentence, which asks models under the workspace's draft budget; reserved until its route is served with what it may spend and a yes.

words.label: Watch this world
words.hint: Be in this world and see what happens in it

entries.reason: A visitor's being in a world and seeing it, which a role may grant; reserved until its route exists.

words.label: Answer for this being
words.hint: Choose what the being you play does in its minute

entries.reason: Answering a played being's minute, which may bring another being's model ask forward at the world's cost; reserved until a role's route carries it.

words.label: Leave
words.hint: Leave this world

entries.reason: Leaving a world, which every role holds and no creator's role may leave out; reserved until its route exists.

words.label: Report
words.hint: Report something in this world to the people who run this server

entries.reason: Reporting a world, a being or a line said in it, which every role holds; reserved until its route exists.
